statement: The recorded “permitted” status is not safe to rely on or established as correct, because this recently carved and imported elephant tusk raises serious U.S. ivory-sale restrictions with no documented exemption.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's "permitted" status is not correct and names the specific issue: "this recently carved and imported elephant tusk raises serious U.S. ivory-sale restrictions with no documented exemption."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
